summary: Eureka Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K to report entry into an amendment to its trust agreement, approved at an extraordinary general meeting on June 29, 2026. The amendment allows monthly extensions of the deadline to complete a business combination, requiring a $8,253.03 monthly fee deposit and a 30-day cure period for missed payments. Failure to cure triggers winding up. No specific price, premium, or deal terms are disclosed. This is a routine SPAC extension filing to maintain trust funds for a future business combination, not a special situation event. Watch for further updates on the target search or potential liquidation if funding lapses.
